items.raw_excerpt: Nesses cinco anos de sede nova, o Museu produziu mais de 1 mil espetáculos e oficinas, e o público chegou a mais de 400 mil visitantes.
items.summary_en: In five years at its new home, the museum put on more than 1,000 shows and workshops. Its visitors passed 400,000. The museum celebrates 50 years of Brazilian popular art.

items.raw_excerpt: "Confidently Wrong" explores urgent healthcare in Mexico through a co-host's real heart surgery story — costs, care and lessons learned.
items.summary_en: A podcast called 'Confidently Wrong' shares a co-host's real heart surgery story in Mexico. It explores the costs, quality of care, and lessons learned about the Mexican healthcare system. The story highlights both the strengths and challenges of seeking medical treatment in Mexico.

items.title_original: ‘Confidently Wrong’ podcast: What one man’s heart surgery story reveals about healthcare in Mexico

items.raw_excerpt: California will require every public high school student, including those at charter schools, to pass a stand-alone financial literacy course.
items.summary_en: California will require every public high school student to pass a standalone financial literacy course. The rule applies to charter schools as well. The course will become a graduation requirement for students across the state.

items.raw_excerpt: Taiwan Railway plans to gradually color-code platform signage, departure screens and information boards -- blue for northbound and green for southbound -- starting at the new Tainan Station, the company said Saturday.
items.summary_en: Taiwan Railway will color-code its signage at the new Tainan Station. Blue marks northbound trains and green marks southbound ones. The system will gradually expand to other stations across the network.

items.raw_excerpt: Ambas partes acercaron posturas para la continuidad del nacional en el "Mengao".
items.summary_en: Chilean midfielder Erick Pulgar has accepted Flamengo's counter-offer to extend his contract with the Brazilian club. Both sides have reportedly reached an agreement for the player to stay at the Rio de Janeiro team.

items.raw_excerpt: Judge Michelle Brass says the meaning of eagle feathers varies between Indigenous communities, and it's especially important for Saulteaux people such as herself.
items.summary_en: Judge Michelle Brass gave eagle feathers to Saskatchewan courtrooms. She says eagle feathers have different meanings across Indigenous communities and are especially important for Saulteaux people.

items.raw_excerpt: A charity built 96 bridges to connect communities separated by rivers and gorges. A new study looks at the life-changing impact of a concrete-and-steel pedestrian crossing.
items.summary_en: A charity built 96 pedestrian bridges across rivers and gorges in Rwanda. The simple crossings are transforming daily life for remote communities by connecting them to schools, markets, and healthcare.

items.title_en: Rwanda's Charity Bridges Link Remote Villages

items.raw_excerpt: A petition has been launched for “urgent action” on public transport for a Co. Galway village this week.
items.summary_en: Residents of a village in County Galway have launched a petition demanding better bus services. They say their community is being left behind due to lack of public transport. Local authorities are being asked to take urgent action.

items.summary_en: Universidad Católica coach Daniel Garnero has named his starting eleven for the Liga de Primera match against O'Higgins. The game will be played on Monday, August 31 at Claro Arena in Santiago. Kickoff is scheduled for 8:45 PM local time.

items.summary_en: A village for homeless people in Bologna will be built in a different location. Neighbors near the first site protested against it. The village is named after Giovanni Tamburi, the 16-year-old who died in Crans-Montana.

items.raw_excerpt: Seleção participa até este domingo com 16 nadadores. Todos foram medalhistas em disputas individuais do último mundial da modalidade, disputado em Singapura, em 2025.
items.summary_en: Brazil's swimming team won medals and set a record on the opening day of the Parapan Pacific Games. The team of 16 swimmers all earned medals at the 2025 World Championships in Singapore.

items.raw_excerpt: Writer Alan Chazaro visits Papantla in Veracruz, an ancestral home to vanilla as well as other travel attractions.
items.summary_en: Alan Chazaro visits Papantla in Veracruz, Mexico. This town is famous for its vanilla heritage and offers many travel attractions. It is a great place to explore local culture and flavors.

items.raw_excerpt: Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar on Saturday inaugurated the 111th birth anniversary celebrations of Shivarathri Rajendra Swami of Suttur Mutt at the Mysuru branch of the mutt on the foothills of Chamundi Hills here.
items.summary_en: Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar inaugurated the 111th birth anniversary celebrations of Shivarathri Rajendra Swami. The event was held at the Mysuru branch of Suttur Mutt on the foothills of Chamundi Hills. Rajendra Swami was a revered spiritual leader of the Suttur Mutt.
items.summary_ko: D.K. 시바쿠마르 주지사가 시바라트리 라젠드라 스와미의 탄신 111주년 기념행사를 개막했습니다. 행사은 Chamundi 언덕 기슭의 Suttur Mutt 마이소르 지점에서 열렸습니다. 라젠드라 스와미는 Suttur Mutt의 존경받는 영적 지도자였습니다.

items.title_original: CM inaugurates 111th Jayanti celebrations of Rajendra Swami

items.raw_excerpt: Iceland has set this year's ptarmigan hunting arrangement, with the season opening October 23.
items.summary_en: Iceland has announced the ptarmigan hunting season for 2026. The season starts on October 23. Hunters must follow the new arrangement set by authorities.

items.raw_excerpt: A mobile library is bringing books, art and cultural activities to children and families in rural communities across Syria.
items.summary_en: A mobile library travels through rural Syria to bring books, art and cultural activities to children and families. The project aims to reach communities with limited access to educational resources. It offers a small but meaningful way for young Syrians to explore reading and creativity.

items.summary_en: A coastal use commission in Chile approved five projects during its second ordinary session. The decision allows fishing coves from Puerto Montt and Quellón to be officially incorporated.

items.raw_excerpt: International African Medicine Day is celebrated every year, on August 31st.
items.summary_en: Traditional healers in South Africa's North West province are calling for a dedicated hospital for traditional medicine. The push comes as the country marks International African Medicine Day on August 31.

items.raw_excerpt: B.C. Hydro says it's monitoring for the reappearance of a mysterious island first spotted by boaters 100 kilometres from the W.A.C. Bennett Dam in northeastern B.C.
items.summary_en: Boaters spotted a mysterious island floating on Williston Lake, about 100 km from the W.A.C. Bennett Dam in northeastern British Columbia. B.C. Hydro is now watching for the island to reappear. No one is sure what caused the land mass to form on the surface.
items.summary_ko: 선원들이 브리티시컬럼비아 북동부 윌리스턴 호수에서 정체불명의 섬을 발견했다. BC 하이드로는 해당 섬이 다시 나타날 때까지 모니터링할 계획이다. 육괴가 호수 수면 위에 형성된 원인은 아직 밝혀지지 않았다.
items.title_en: A floating island appeared and vanished on a huge lake in British Columbia
